positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented Additive Reality feature to highlight player movements in US Open replays using Python and XML
• Additive Reality was broadcast on ESPN
• Designed and implemented Selective Reality feature to isolate players of interest in NBA and NFL replays using Python and XML
• Selective Reality was the first new feature aired in a live game in over 2 years
• Developed GUI and linear regression algorithm to grade the quality of sports replays with Python
• Wrote Undistort user manual and trained others on how to perform procedure

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Tested integration of 12 IPs within a subsystem using Perl and Tcl

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Developed MySQL database to track statistics for design verification
• Parsed and extracted data from log files generated by synthesis tools with Python
• Designed and tested schema using MySQL Workbench
• Created graphical user interface for database with PHP and JavaScript

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Designed ASIC hardware and testbenches with SystemVerilog
• Wrote technical documents for project plans including flow charts, state diagrams, and logic gate schematics
• Analyzed waveforms in Discovery Verification Environment
• Attended SystemVerilog Testbench Workshop at Synopsys
• Presented solutions to manager, and explained test results

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with Data Integration team to automate the transfer of information from client's database to Blackboard's system
• Analyzed database structures and information tracking policies at client organizations 
• Customized visual basic scripts to automate tasks
• Wrote SQL queries to extract required data from customer databases in the appropriate format 
• Clearly communicated the automation process to clients and answered technical questions they had regarding the process via phone and email
• Used Salesforce CRM software to log all actions on work completed
